thread:
maria_product: Heads-up — annual product strategy weekend planning thread. Need quick confirmation on facilitation owners, required pre-reads, and travel logistics. thinking hybrid (in-person + optional zoom rooms).

kelly_pmo: +1 hybrid. can we lock venue by Fri? we have 40 ppl onsite potential. any hard blockers? :calendar: 

maria_product: aiming to finalize venue + travel by end of week. Main asks: 1) facilitators for three breakout tracks 2) pre-read packet + 48h delivery 3) a lightweight async option for remote attendees.

alex_design: I can facilitate the customer journey mapping track. will prepare a 10min intro + templates.

sam_engineering: i'll take platform & ops tradeoffs (30m). will bring perf/cost slides and a short demo. need a projector and a remote HDMI adapter.

kelly_pmo: thanks. @maria_product can you list the three tracks you want covered so we can divvy up roles? also we should set a facilitator grooming call next Tue.

maria_product: tracks = ["Roadmap prioritization & OKR alignment", "Serving economics + tradeoffs (batching/quant)", "Customer-driven feature scoping & launch criteria"]

liz_ops: I can own logistics: catering, badges, sign-in, and a ride-share spreadsheet for folks flying in. will post link soon.

calendar-bot: Event created: "Redwood Product Strategy Weekend" • May 14-15 • 09:00-17:00 PT • Location: The Dockhouse, SF • Zoom rooms configured

maria_product: perfect — for pre-reads: keep them short. ask each facilitator for a one-pager + 6-slide deck. deadline = Thu 9am. include 3 focus prompts and 2 example artifacts.

alex_design: posting template now:
```
One-pager:
- TL;DR (1 sentence)
- Key tradeoffs (bullet)
- Decisions to make (3)
- Success criteria / launch signals
```

sam_engineering: re: remote async flow — propose Miro boards per track + 2 short Looms (intro + key demo). remote folks should be able to contribute to synth notes.

kelly_pmo: logistics checklist (short):
- book venue + confirm A/V
- travel stipends & ride-share sheet
- dietary form & onsite catering
- nametags + seating plan
- print 1 pager pack for onsite

liz_ops: ride-share sheet: https://tiny.redwood/ride-share-weekend (pls add travel times)

maria_product: can we offer 1-way airport pick-up for late arrivals? budget ok for two shuttles. @liz_ops pls coordinate.

liz_ops: noted. will draft shuttle schedule. also will add a column for accessibility needs.

alex_design: facilitation note — let's run a 6-min divergent ideation + 18-min convergent breakouts (2 rounds) for the scoping track. need a timer and breakout facilitators.

sam_engineering: i can prep a 3-slide perf baseline: current p95, cost per token, and a demo of batching savings. will include a short config snippet for infra runbook: 
```
# perf baseline snippet
requests_per_sec: 120
avg_seq_len: 64
batch_size: 16
```

kelly_pmo: action items: @alex_design prepare templates (due Thu 9am), @sam_engineering slides + config (due Thu 9am), @maria_product assemble pre-read pack and send to all (Thu 12pm), @liz_ops finalize ride-share + shuttle (Thu EOD).

maria_product: good. one more ask — capture the launch-criteria template we use for product rollouts so everyone can reason about scope tradeoffs during prioritization. i'll drop the template in the thread shortly.

calendar-bot: Reminder set: facilitator grooming call • Tue 10:00 PT • 1716060000

liz_ops: quick Q on accommodations — should we reserve a block at the Dockhouse hotel or send folks to nearby hotels? block is limited.

kelly_pmo: prefer block for ease, but keep a few overflow options. i'll hold 20 rooms provisionally for 2 nights.

alex_design: small ask — can the remote deck include hi-contrast slides and a copy of Miro templates. remote UX suffers if we don't prep.

maria_product: agreed. add accessibility checklist to pre-reads: captions, slide contrast, alt text for images.

sam_engineering: FYI, i'll need a small blackbox for the demo. ping me if you want to rehearse.

maria_product: last thing — for decision-making cadence: let's run a speed-ranking exercise and then use dot-vote for final top 5 initiatives. will post instructions.

liz_ops: posted shuttle draft and ride-share signups. pls add ETA in the sheet.

kelly_pmo: leaving a note for all facilitators — please join grooming call Tue even if remote. we'll do a 30m run-through of activities.

maria_product: thanks everyone. i'll compile the pre-read pack after Thu and post final logistics Friday morning. :rocket: 

sam_engineering: noted, thanks.

alex_design: thanks — looking forward.

liz_ops: will follow up with catering dietary form. "
